label: Color correction
note: Choose a filter to adjust colors on the glasses display.
note_it: Scegli un filtro per regolare i colori sul display degli occhiali.
note_zh: 选择滤镜来调整眼镜显示屏的色彩。

label: Color correction
note: Turns color correction on or off. Changing it wakes the display.

label: Enable magnification
note: Turns the glasses' custom accessibility service on or off. TalkBack stays as it was.

label: Action button prompt
note: Text sent to Meta AI when the action button runs a custom prompt.
note_zh: 当操作按钮运行自定义提示语时发送给 Meta AI 的文本。

label: Long press prompt
note: Text Meta AI gets when a long press of the action button runs your custom prompt.

label: Action button Spotify link
note: The Spotify link the action button opens, spotify:playlist:… and the like.

label: Active device
note: Shows whether these glasses are the active device. The system sets it, not the user.

label: Advanced video quality
note: Turns on an advanced video quality profile for the camera. The exact video change is not decoded.

label: Mock business phone number
note: Stored only. Nothing on the glasses reads this number.

label: AI lens suggestions
note: Shows AI lens suggestions in Live AI.

label: Airship developer mode
note: Developer switch the phone syncs to the glasses. Nothing on the glasses acts on it.

label: Block explicit songs
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses blocks explicit songs.

label: iPhone notifications
note: Lets the glasses show notifications from an iPhone over Bluetooth Low Energy.

label: Action button long press
label_it: Pressione prolungata del pulsante di azione
note: What the action button does when you hold it.
note_zh: 长按操作按钮时的功能。

options.label: Custom Meta AI prompt
options.label_zh: 自定义 Meta AI 提示语

options.label: Pause or resume announcements
options.label_it: Metti in pausa o riprendi gli annunci

label: Action button press
note: What the action button does when you press it once.
note_zh: 轻按一次操作按钮时的功能。

options.label: Custom Meta AI prompt
options.label_zh: 自定义 Meta AI 提示语

options.label: Pause or resume announcements
options.label_it: Metti in pausa o riprendi gli annunci

label: Action button light
note: Which light the action button uses. The value names are not decoded yet, so it is read-only. Value names are not decoded, so the app must not write it.

label: AI phone calls
note: Turns on Meta AI phone calls. The glasses do not read it.

label: AI phone calls (test)
note: Test switch for AI phone calls. Nothing on the glasses acts on it; it is stored only.

label: Assistant audio mode
note: Nothing on the glasses reads this setting. Integer stored and synced only; no code on the glasses reads it.

label: Auto-trim videos
note: Auto-trim for videos Meta AI captures. Nothing on the glasses acts on it; it is stored and synced.

label: Messaging apps (old packed form)
note: The older packed form of the messaging app settings, one byte per app. The glasses hold 0 and use the newer setting.

label: Messaging app settings
note: Per messaging app: whether it is on, whether messages are announced or read out, and whether a reply is allowed.

App.label: Wake the glasses on a notification

label: Detailed Meta AI logs
note: Turns on more detailed logs for Meta AI on the glasses.

label: Assistant logging level
note: Logging detail for the Meta AI assistant. Developer setting; the binary names no levels.

label: Meta AI display
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Meta AI
note: Turns Meta AI on or off on the glasses.
note_zh: 开启或关闭眼镜上的 Meta AI。

label: Respond without "Hey Meta"
note: Your glasses' microphone will stay on and listen for another prompt for a brief period after your prompt is completed. You can skip saying "Hey Meta."
note_it: Dopo il completamento del prompt, il microfono dei tuoi occhiali resterà attivo e in ascolto per un breve periodo per eventuali altri prompt. Puoi fare a meno di dire "Hey Meta".
note_zh: 在你说完提示语后的一小段时间内，眼镜的麦克风会保持开启并继续聆听下一个指令。你可以省去说“Hey Meta”。

label: On-device language model
note: Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Meta AI vision
note: Meta AI vision switch. Nothing on the glasses or phone reads it; it is stored and synced only.

label: Preview via file handle
note: Developer switch for previewing assistant media through a file handle.

label: Store Meta AI photos and videos
note: Keeps the photos and videos Meta AI processes. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Store voice recordings
note: Lets Meta keep recordings of what you say to Meta AI.
note_zh: 允许 Meta 保留你对 Meta AI 说话时的录音。

label: Store transcripts
note: Store a text copy and related data of what you say.
note_it: Memorizza una copia scritta di quello che dici e i dati correlati.
note_zh: 保存你说的话的文字副本及相关数据。

label: Meta AI voice
note: The voice Meta AI speaks with.

label: Voice verification
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Custom wake word
note: The custom wake phrase, if one is set.

label: Reduce interruptions
note: Waits to deliver notifications until you're no longer speaking.
note_it: Aspetta che tu finisca di parlare per consegnare le notifiche.
note_zh: 等你说完话后再为你送达通知。

label: Audio balance
note: Adjust the balance between the left and right channels.
note_it: Regola il bilanciamento tra il canale sinistro e quello destro.
note_zh: 调整左右声道的平衡。

label: Audio noise reduction
note: Reduces background noise in video audio when the phone processes it.
note_zh: 由手机处理时，降低视频音频中的背景噪声。

label: Listen while recording
note: Audio will continue to play when capturing videos
note_it: La riproduzione dell'audio continuerà mentre registri video
note_zh: 拍摄视频时音频将继续播放。

label: Pause music when glasses come off
label_it: Metti in pausa la musica quando togli gli occhiali
note: Pauses music when the glasses come off.
note_zh: 摘下眼镜时暂停播放音乐。

label: Autocapture action test
note: Adds the activity type to the autocapture experiences the glasses run.

label: Autocapture sounds
note: Your glasses will make a sound each time an autocapture starts and stops.
note_it: I tuoi occhiali emetteranno un suono ogni volta che l'acquisizione automatica viene avviata e interrotta.
note_zh: 每次自动捕获开始和结束时，眼镜都会发出提示音。

label: Autocapture capture mode
note: Capture mode for autocapture. Nothing on the glasses reads it; the value is stored and synced.

label: Motion data stream
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Autocapture MCU mode
note: Switches autocapture to MCU mode. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Motion capture mode
note: Mode for motion-triggered autocapture. The values are not named in the code, so it is read-only. Values are not named in the code, so no options can be offered.

label: Motion-triggered autocapture
note: Motion-triggered autocapture switch. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Motion capture clip length
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this clip length; it is stored and synced only.

label: Interactive autocapture
note: Adds interactive autocapture to the glasses' capture experiences.

label: Autocapture interval
note: Time between autocapture clips. The code does not give the unit; the default is 15.

label: Long autocapture test
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Switch to low power mode
note: Say "Hey Meta, switch to low power autocapture."
label_it: Passa alla modalità di risparmio energetico
note_it: Di' "Hey Meta, passa all'acquisizione automatica con risparmio energetico."
note_zh: 说“Hey Meta, switch to low power autocapture.”

label: Motion autocapture test
note: Experiment switch for motion autocapture. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Low resolution autocapture on phone
note: Changes how autocapture runs alongside video on the glasses. Off by default.

label: Autocapture session length
note: Default length of an autocapture session. The unit is not stated in the code read.

label: Viewfinder
note: See what you’re capturing when your display is on.
note_it: Vedi cosa stai acquisendo quando il display è acceso.
note_zh: 显示屏亮起时，可以看到正在拍摄的内容。

label: Timed motion-sensor autocapture
note: Adds timed autocapture that uses the motion sensor to the glasses' capture experiences.

label: Timed interval capture mode
note: Capture mode for timed-interval autocapture. Nothing on the glasses reads it; it is stored and synced.

label: Timed interval captures
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Timed interval clip length
note: Length of each clip in timed-interval autocapture. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Autocapture clip length
note: Length of each autocapture clip, as the Meta app sets it. Nothing on the glasses reads it. No unit or bounds in the code, so no range can be offered.

label: Adaptive volume
note: Automatically adjust glasses volume based on your environment.
note_it: Regola automaticamente il volume degli occhiali in base al tuo ambiente.
note_zh: 根据所处环境自动调节眼镜音量。

label: Battery saver
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Bluetooth message access
note: Nothing on the glasses reads this setting. Integer status stored and synced only; no code on the glasses reads it.

label: Detailed responses
note: You'll hear more about objects, signage and people. Do not use as a mobility aid.
note_it: Sentirai altre informazioni su oggetti, segnali e persone. Non usare come ausilio per la mobilità.
note_zh: 你会听到更多关于物体、标识和人员的描述。请勿将其用作行动辅助工具。

label: Camera use
note: Lets Meta AI use the glasses camera. Off stops Meta AI camera use.

label: Touchpad: one-finger double tap
note: Key sent for a one-finger double tap on the touchpad.

label: Touchpad: one-finger long press
note: Key sent when the touchpad sees a one-finger long press.

label: Touchpad: one-finger long press release
note: Key sent when a one-finger long press on the touchpad ends. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Touchpad: one-finger swipe down
note: Key sent for a one-finger swipe down. Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Touchpad: one-finger swipe forward
note: Sets the key sent for a one-finger forward swipe. No code on the glasses reads it.

label: Touchpad: one-finger swipe back
note: Keycode for a one-finger swipe back on the touchpad. Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Touchpad: one-finger swipe up
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Touchpad: one-finger tap
note: Key sent for a one-finger tap on the touchpad.

label: Touchpad: two-finger double tap
note: Key sent for a two-finger double tap. Nothing on the glasses reads this key.

label: Touchpad: two-finger long press
note: Key sent when a two-finger long press on the touchpad starts. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Touchpad: two-finger long press release
note: Key sent when a two-finger long press ends. Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Touchpad: two-finger swipe down
note: Sets the key sent for a two-finger downward swipe. No code on the glasses reads it.

label: Touchpad: two-finger swipe forward
note: Keycode for a two-finger swipe forward on the touchpad. Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Touchpad: two-finger swipe back
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Touchpad: two-finger swipe up
note: Key sent for a two-finger swipe up. No firmware code reads it, so it does nothing on its own.

label: Touchpad: two-finger tap
note: Key sent for a two-finger tap. Default is back.

label: Touchpad gestures
note: Turn off the touchpad until you close the hinges to avoid accidental gestures.
note_it: Disattiva il touchpad finché non chiudi le astine per evitare gesti accidentali.
note_zh: 关闭触控板，直到合上镜腿以避免误触手势。

label: Media orientation
note: Portrait (3:4) or landscape (4:3) photos and videos. The glasses always take the whole portrait frame; Visor crops landscape ones to 4:3 as it brings them over.
note_it: Foto e video in verticale (3:4) o in orizzontale (4:3). Gli occhiali scattano sempre l'intera inquadratura verticale; Visor ritaglia quelli orizzontali a 4:3 quando li importa.
note_zh: 竖版（3:4）或横版（4:3）照片和视频。眼镜始终拍摄完整的竖版画面；Visor 在传输时会把横版画面裁剪为 4:3。

label: Auto review
note: Auto review provides a quick glance at what you've captured, making it easy to review and share on the go.
note_it: Il controllo automatico fornisce una rapida panoramica del contenuto acquisito, per controllarlo e condividerlo facilmente ovunque ti trovi.
note_zh: 自动回看可让你快速浏览刚拍摄的内容，方便随时查看和分享。

label: Capture button assistant shortcut
note: Assistant shortcut bound to the capture button. Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Capture button double press
note: Stored on the glasses only. The double press is handled without reading it. No value list or bounds in code; the double press uses a fixed key code.

label: Capture button
note: Swaps what a short and a long press of the capture button do: photo or video.

options.label: Photo-first (default)
options.detail: Pressing the capture button once will take a photo. Press and hold will record a video.
options.detail_it: Premi il pulsante di acquisizione una volta per scattare una foto. Tienilo premuto per registrare video.
options.detail_ru: Одно нажатие кнопки съёмки делает фото. Нажатие с удержанием записывает видео.

options.label: Video-first
options.detail: Pressing the capture button once will record a video. Press and hold will take photos.
options.detail_it: Premi il pulsante di acquisizione una volta per registrare video. Tienilo premuto per scattare foto.
options.detail_ru: Одно нажатие кнопки съёмки записывает видео. Нажатие с удержанием делает фото.

label: Alternative capture modes
note: Choose what the action button does

options.label: Hyperlapse
options.detail: Condense long time lapses into short, shareable clips.
options.detail_it: Condensa lunghi time-lapse in brevi clip da condividere.
options.detail_zh: 将长时间的延时摄影压缩成简短、可分享的片段。
options.detail_ru: Сжимает долгую съёмку в короткие клипы, которыми удобно делиться.

options.label: Slow motion
options.detail_zh: 以 4 倍慢动作录制视频。

options.label: Autocapture
options.detail: Automatically capture photos of important things around you
options.detail_it: Acquisisci automaticamente foto dei momenti importanti intorno a te.
options.detail_zh: 自动拍摄周围重要事物的照片
options.detail_ru: Автоматически снимает фото важных моментов вокруг вас.

note_it: Scegli che azione associare al pulsante di azione
note_zh: 选择操作按钮的功能

label: Long press for capture mode
note: Long press on the capture button. Values are not decoded; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Carrier MMS size limit
note: Largest MMS size the carrier allows. Nothing on the glasses acts on it; it is stored only.

label: Cellular data
note: Updates will use cellular data if you're not connected to Wi-Fi.
note_it: Gli aggiornamenti useranno i dati cellulare se non hai una connessione Wi-Fi.
note_zh: 未连接 Wi-Fi 时，更新将使用蜂窝数据。

label: Camera use
note: When you interact with Meta AI, an image may be taken.
note_it: Quando interagisci con Meta AI, potrebbe essere scattata una foto.
note_zh: 与 Meta AI 交互时，可能会拍摄一张图像。

label: Cloud media
note: Allow your photos and videos to be sent to Meta's cloud for processing and temporary storage.
note_it: Consenti l'invio delle tue foto e dei tuoi video al cloud di Meta per l'elaborazione e la memorizzazione temporanea.
note_zh: 允许将你的照片和视频发送至 Meta 云端进行处理和临时存储。

label: Automatic updates
note: Lets the glasses check for and download firmware updates from the cloud.

label: Factory reset after update check
note: Stored flag for a factory reset after an update check. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Preferred update bandwidth
note: Preferred network for downloading glasses updates. Values are not decoded.

label: Messages while in case
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Messaging phone number
note: This phone's number for calls and messages through the glasses.

label: Phone app language
note: Language of the phone app, sent to the glasses so they match it. The phone sets it from its own locale.

label: Companion developer mode
note: Developer flag the phone writes. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Phone encryption key ID
note: Identifier of the phone's encryption key, written during relay setup. Not for editing.

label: This phone's numbers
note: The SIM numbers of the phone, for SMS and MMS relay through the glasses.

label: Phone relay status
note: Phone relay state, as the phone reports it. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Connections
note: Turns the connections feature on or off. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Constellation state
note: State string kept for the partner fulfillment service. No user choice exists.

label: Navigation reassurance distance
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this distance; it is stored and synced only.

label: Continuous AI camera schedule
note: Profiles of settings and the weekly windows that switch between them. The glasses check the layout, not the version number.

label: Continuous AI camera chunk length
note: Length of each continuous AI camera capture chunk, in seconds.

label: Continuous AI camera feedback
note: How the glasses signal when continuous AI camera runs: light, sound, speech, or a mix.

options.label: LED light, sound and spoken feedback

label: Continuous AI camera
note: Turns continuous AI camera capture on or off.

label: Continuous AI camera frame rate
note: Frame rate for continuous AI camera captures. The service applies a change while it runs. No bounds in the code, so no safe range can be offered.

label: Headband mode
note: Headband mode for the continuous AI camera. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Light on while the AI camera is paused
note: Keeps the notification light on while the continuous AI camera is paused. The light while recording is separate.

label: AI camera paused
note: Pauses the continuous AI camera.

label: Conversation focus early access
note: Early-access switch for conversation focus in the hearing service.

label: Conversation focus region gate
note: Region gate for conversation focus, set by the system. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Conversation focus eligibility
note: Conversation focus early access flag. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Conversation focus early-access values
note: Developer switch: use early-access values for conversation focus instead of server settings.

label: Share crowdsourced data
note: Turns sharing of crowdsourced data on or off. The location service reads it.

label: Share location for crowdsourcing
note: Lets crowdsourced data include the glasses' location.

label: Share Wi-Fi data for crowdsourcing
note: Lets crowdsourced location data include Wi-Fi scans.

label: Current music app
note: The media app the glasses' controls act on, as the phone reports it.

label: Custom wake phrase
note: Uses a phrase you record as a voice command trigger, in addition to Hey Meta.

label: Dash cam segment length
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it. No bounds or value list in code. Length is in milliseconds.

label: Dashcam fall detection
note: Dashcam fall detection switch. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Dashcam resolution
note: Dashcam resolution and frame rate. Nothing on the glasses reads it, so it changes nothing yet.

label: Debug video capture mode
note: Internal capture mode for debugging. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Default music provider
note: Stored as a number that picks the default music app.

label: Default apps by category
note: Sets which phone app handles each category, such as music.

label: Default SMS app
note: Package name of the phone's default SMS app. Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Detailed Live AI answers
label_zh: 详细的 Live AI 回答
note: Gives more detailed answers in Live AI.
note_zh: 让 Live AI 提供更详细的回答。

label: Charging LEDs (developer)
note: Developer switch for the LEDs shown while charging. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Developer Mode
note: If you are developing for Meta AI Glasses, Developer Mode allows you to use features required for app development
note_it: Se stai sviluppando contenuti per gli AI glasses di Meta, la modalità sviluppatore ti consente di usare le funzioni richieste per lo sviluppo di app
note_zh: 如果你在为 Meta AI Glasses 开发应用，开发者模式可让你使用应用开发所需的功能

label: Name
note: The name you give these glasses. Free text.

label: Privacy identifier
note: Privacy identifier from Meta's server. The user cannot set it on the device.

label: Share additional data
note: By default, Meta collects the data needed to make your devices work properly. You may also share additional data, including things like how often you wear your glasses pushed back on your head, instead of on your nose.
note_it: Per impostazione predefinita, Meta raccoglie i dati necessari per il corretto funzionamento dei tuoi dispositivi. Puoi anche condividere dati aggiuntivi, come la frequenza con cui indossi gli occhiali appoggiati sopra la testa invece che sul naso.
note_zh: 默认情况下，Meta 会收集让设备正常运行所必需的数据。你也可以共享更多数据，例如你佩戴眼镜时是推在头顶还是架在鼻梁上的频次。

label: Devkit developer mode
note: Developer mode for the devkit build. Nothing on the glasses reads it; stored and synced.

label: Display mapping
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Early Access
note: Whether Meta counts these glasses for its early access programme. Meta's server sets it; already on here.

label: Early access programme
note: Your opt-in to Meta's early access features.

label: Education partner 1
note: Turns on the first education partner. The assistant binary reads the switch.

label: Video stabilization
note: How the camera stabilizes video.
note_zh: 相机稳定视频的方式。

options.label: Auto-select
options.detail: Default / High, med or low stabilization selected automatically based on video motion
options.detail_it: Stabilizzazione predefinita, alta, media o bassa selezionata automaticamente in base al movimento del video
options.detail_zh: 默认。根据视频画面的晃动情况自动选择高、中或低防抖
options.detail_ru: Стандартная, высокая, средняя или низкая стабилизация выбирается автоматически по движению в кадре

options.label: Medium
options.detail_zh: 一定程度的防抖和水平校正

options.label: Low
options.detail: Maintains action but removes high jitter
options.detail_it: Mantiene l'azione ma rimuove il jitter elevato
options.detail_zh: 保留动态感，同时消除明显抖动
options.detail_ru: Сохраняет динамику, но убирает сильную тряску

label: Band instant action
note: The action the neural band runs on an instant gesture, stored as a number.

label: Calendar alerts
note: Get alerts for upcoming calendar events
note_it: Ricevi avvisi per gli eventi in programma del calendario
note_zh: 获取即将到来的日历事件提醒

label: Read event details
note: Read out event details
note_it: Leggi i dettagli dell'evento ad alta voce
note_zh: 朗读事件详情

label: Wake display
note: Wake the display for calendar notifications
note_it: Attiva il display per le notifiche del calendario
note_zh: 日历通知到达时唤醒显示屏

label: Calling with Meta AI
label_zh: 使用 Meta AI 通话
note: Switch for calling with Meta AI. The glasses carry the flag in their config tables.
note_zh: 与 Meta AI 通话的开关。眼镜的配置表中会保存该标志位。

label: Google Calendar alerts
note: Alerts you on the glasses for Google Calendar events.

label: Nova ICA
note: Gate for Nova-based Meta AI calling. Set through MobileConfig.

label: Audio notifications
note: Enable calendar event audio alerts
note_it: Abilita gli avvisi audio degli eventi del calendario
note_zh: 启用日历事件的声音提醒

label: Read event details
note: Read out event details
note_it: Leggi i dettagli dell'evento ad alta voce
note_zh: 朗读事件详情

label: Wake display
note: Wake the display for calendar notifications
note_it: Attiva il display per le notifiche del calendario
note_zh: 日历通知到达时唤醒显示屏

label: Sync call log to glasses
label_it: Sincronizza il registro chiamate con gli occhiali
label_zh: 将通话记录同步到眼镜
note: Stored and synced to the glasses. Nothing on the glasses uses it.
note_zh: 存储并同步到眼镜。眼镜上没有任何功能会使用它。

label: Sync contacts to glasses
label_it: Sincronizza i contatti con gli occhiali
note: Sync phone contacts to the glasses. Nothing on the glasses reads this key.
note_zh: 将手机通讯录同步到眼镜。眼镜上没有任何功能会读取该配置项。

label: SMS and MMS relay
note: Relay setting for SMS and MMS messages. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Untethered relay
note: Relay setting. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Warp in air
note: Changing it makes the assistant shut down its warp feature.

label: Exposure adjustment
note: Shifts camera exposure up or down. Float exposure offset; the code read gives no bounds.

label: Fast authentication
note: Stored and synced only. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Example rollout flag
note: Test flag for the settings rollout system. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Flicker reduction

note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

note: Reports whether the glasses are the C50 model. Set by the system.

label: C50 in-app Meta AI flag
note: Turns in-app Meta AI on or off for the C50 flag.

label: Landscape mode
note: The older landscape switch. Visor keeps it in line with Media orientation.
note_it: Il vecchio interruttore orizzontale. Visor lo tiene allineato all'orientamento dei contenuti multimediali.
note_zh: 旧的横屏开关。Visor 会让它与媒体方向保持一致。

label: Language pack build

label: Discreet audio sensitivity
note: Adjust to your level of comfort
note_it: Regola in base al tuo livello di comfort
note_zh: 调整到你舒适的级别。

label: Discreet audio sensitivity
note: Adjust to your level of comfort
note_it: Regola in base al tuo livello di comfort
note_zh: 调整到你舒适的级别。

label: Lens brightness
note: Lens brightness value. Stored and synced; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Lens tint
note: Sets the lens tint to clear, auto, dark or mid.

label: Lens tint toggle mode
note: Lens tint toggle mode. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Live AI
note: Turns Live AI on or off.
note_zh: 开启或关闭 Live AI。

label: Live AI faster stream start
note: Starts the Live AI media stream in the background. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Live AI voice only
note: Sets Live AI to voice only. The phone sends this flag with each voice stream.
note_zh: 将 Live AI 设置为仅语音。手机会在每次语音流传输时发送该标志位。

label: Live caption voice
note: Sets the voice used for live captions.

label: Live notes consent
note: Records that the user agreed to live notes. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Live translation early access
note: Turns on the early-access version of live speech translation.

label: Live translation on server
note: Turns on server-side live speech translation. Off by default.

label: Live translation voice
note: Voice used to speak live translations.

label: Location tags on photos
note: Whether photos and videos get a location tag. The glasses do not read it.
note_zh: 决定是否为照片和视频添加位置标记。眼镜不会读取该设置。

label: Location for Meta AI
note: Lets Meta AI use the phone's location for glasses requests. When off, location requests are refused.
note_zh: 允许 Meta AI 在处理眼镜请求时使用手机位置。关闭后将拒绝位置请求。

label: Location services
note: Turns location on or off for the glasses.
note_zh: 为眼镜开启或关闭位置功能。

label: Device management
note: Device management flag. Nothing on the glasses acts on it; stored and synced.

label: Auto level
note: Automatically frame your captures for best quality.
note_it: Inquadra automaticamente le tue acquisizioni per la migliore qualità.
note_zh: 自动调整取景，以获得最佳画质。

label: Cloud features for media
label_it: Funzioni cloud per i contenuti multimediali
note: Lets Meta AI use the cloud for photos and videos.
note_zh: 允许 Meta AI 在云端处理照片和视频。

label: Band media: index finger single tap
note: Key the band sends for an index-finger single tap, meant for media. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Band media: middle finger single tap
note: Key sent for a middle finger single tap on the band, for media. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Band media: thumb swipe down
note: Key sent for a thumb swipe down on the neural band. Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Band media: thumb swipe left
note: Sets the key sent for a thumb swipe left on the neural band. No code on the glasses reads it.

label: Band media: thumb swipe right
note: Keycode for a thumb swipe right on the neural band. Nothing on the glasses reads this setting.

label: Band media: thumb swipe up
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Media quality
note: Automatically crop captures when the camera is partially blocked by objects like a hat brim or hair.
note_it: Ritaglia automaticamente le acquisizioni quando la fotocamera è parzialmente bloccata da elementi come tese di cappelli o capelli.
note_zh: 当相机被帽檐、头发等物体部分遮挡时，自动裁剪拍摄画面。

label: Messenger contacts sync
note: Messenger contacts sync flag set by the phone. Nothing on the glasses reads it. Values are not named in the code; the phone sync sets it.

label: Meta AI handwriting
note: Turns on Meta AI handwriting input. The assistant runtime reads it as a switch.

label: Meta AI during calls
note: Lets Meta AI start while a phone call is active instead of being blocked.

label: Metadata
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Miranda DC service
note: Internal service flag. Nothing on the glasses reads it; stored and synced.

label: Mirrored notification apps
note: Per-app notification mirroring settings, stored on the glasses. Not for editing.

label: Double press for Meta AI
note: Setting for the double press that opens Meta AI. The glasses do not read it.

label: Meta AI consent
note: Consent record for multimodal Meta AI features. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Rollout target state
note: Rollout target of an internal config. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Mono audio
note: Play the same audio from the left and right speakers.
note_it: Riproduci lo stesso audio dagli altoparlanti sinistro e destro.
note_zh: 左右扬声器播放相同的声音。

label: Motion blur reduction
note: Turns motion blur reduction on or off for video.
note_zh: 开启或关闭视频的动态模糊降低。

label: Media processing for photos
note: Turns media processing of unprocessed photos on or off.

label: Media processing for videos
note: Turns media processing of unprocessed videos on or off.

label: Playback while recording
note: Allow media to play while recording videos. Sound from your media may be captured.
note_it: Consenti la riproduzione di contenuti multimediali mentre registri video. Potrebbe essere registrato il suono dei tuoi contenuti multimediali.
note_zh: 允许在录制视频时播放媒体。媒体中的声音可能会被录入。

label: Third music partner
note: Turns on a third music partner app.

label: Default pause length
note: Default length of an announcement pause.
note_zh: 公告暂停的默认时长。

label: Announcements paused until
note: Time until incoming call announcements stay muted, as epoch seconds. Empty means not muted.

label: Announcement pause mode
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this value; it is stored and synced only.

label: Talk without the wake phrase
label_it: Parla senza la frase di attivazione
note: Lets you talk to the assistant without saying the wake phrase first.
note_zh: 无需先说出唤醒词，即可直接与助手对话。

label: Nose occlusion tuning
note: Tuning flag for how the nose is detected in the camera view.

label: Notification LED brightness
note: Brightness of the alert light. The Java LED code uses one fixed level whatever this is set to.
note_zh: 提示灯的亮度。无论此项如何设置，Java LED 代码都使用同一个固定亮度。

label: Notification volume
note: Level of notification sounds on the audio system's absolute scale.
note_zh: 通知提示音在音频系统绝对音量刻度上的级别。

label: Occlusion detection
note: Detects when something blocks the camera view.
note_zh: 检测是否有物体遮挡相机视野。

label: Setup session id
note: Id of the first-time setup session.

label: Oxide
note: Runs the Oxide and Meta AI services and sends the wake word to Meta AI.

label: Paired phone system
note: Records the type of phone the glasses are paired with. Nothing on the glasses acts on it. Phone type the glasses record when paired; nothing for the user to change.

label: Palm unlock early access
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Palm unlock
note: Securely unlock your glasses without using your phone.
note_it: Sblocca in modo sicuro i tuoi occhiali senza usare il tuo telefono.
note_zh: 无需手机即可安全解锁眼镜。

label: Partner app settings
note: Settings and display info for partner apps, stored as a protobuf the phone app writes.

label: Passive audio capture
note: Background audio capture switch for the glasses assistant.

label: Passive audio: own speech only
note: Limits passive audio capture to the own speech of the wearer. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Passive meal capture
note: Turns passive meal capture on or off. Off by default.

label: Passive phone unlock
note: Turns passive phone unlock on or off.
note_zh: 开启或关闭被动解锁手机。

label: Passive visual capture
note: Turns passive camera capture on or off. The phone app settings page writes it.
note_zh: 开启或关闭被动相机拍摄。该项由手机应用的设置页面写入。

label: Phone contacts sync
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it. Integer the phone app writes; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Posture detection
note: Turns posture detection on or off. The phone app lists it; the glasses do not read it.
note_zh: 开启或关闭佩戴姿态检测。手机应用会列出该选项，但眼镜不会读取它。

label: India QR payments (MC)
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: India QR payments setup done
note: Records that the India QR payments setup is done.

label: QR payments in India
note: Turns QR payments on or off in India.

label: UPI eligible
note: Eligibility flag for UPI payments. Set by the system, not the user.

label: QR payments via WhatsApp
note: Turns on QR payments through WhatsApp in India.

label: Quick action
note: Chooses what the quick action does: send a message, a voice message, or a call.
note_zh: 选择快捷操作执行的内容：发送消息、语音消息或拨打电话。

options.label: Voice messaging

options.detail_it: Disponibile solo per WhatsApp, Messenger e Instagram
options.detail_zh: 仅适用于 WhatsApp、Messenger 和 Instagram
options.detail_ru: Только для WhatsApp, Messenger и Instagram

label: Dynamic photo
note: Capture more frames with each photo, so you can choose your favorite.
note_it: Acquisisci più fotogrammi con ogni foto per scegliere quello che preferisci.
note_zh: 每张照片拍摄更多画面，方便你挑选最喜欢的。

label: QVA
note: Turns on the QVA audio feature, which the audio server only enables on one device model.

label: QVA wellness sync
note: Syncs wellness data. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Reminders early access
note: Turns the early-access reminders feature on or off.

label: Resolution and frame rate
note: Changing resolution or frame rate affects battery life, storage, recording duration, and orientation.
note_it: La modifica della risoluzione o della frequenza dei fotogrammi influisce su autonomia della batteria, spazio, durata di registrazione e orientamento.
note_zh: 更改分辨率或帧率会影响电池续航、存储空间、录制时长和拍摄方向。

label: Sample app 1
note: Test toggle for a sample app. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Screen brightness
note: Sets display brightness. The stored value is a level; the brightness controls also take 1 to 100 percent.

label: Auto brightness
note: Adjusts glasses display brightness based on your environment
note_it: Regola la luminosità del display degli occhiali in base all'ambiente circostante
note_zh: 根据环境光线自动调整眼镜显示屏亮度

label: SDR video
note: Turns SDR video on or off. The glasses' camera UI reads it.

label: Account sync metadata
note: Account sync data kept as a string. Not for editing.

label: Action button long press (flag)
note: Long press on the action button. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Action button short press (flag)
note: Old flag for the action button short press. The action button mapping setting is used instead.

label: Mirror phone notifications
note: Lets phone notifications show on the glasses.

label: Touchpad interaction model
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this value; it is stored and synced only.

label: Touchpad model coherence
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it. Integer; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Invert swipe horizontal
note: Reverses horizontal swipes on the touchpad.
note_zh: 反转触控板上的水平滑动方向。

label: Invert swipe vertical
note: Reverses vertical swipes on the touchpad.
note_zh: 反转触控板上的垂直滑动方向。

label: Invert swipe horizontal
note: Stored and synced only. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Invert swipe vertical
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Disable thermal shutdown
note: Stops the glasses shutting down when a skin sensor reads too hot. For testing.

label: Display heat protection
note: For glasses with a display; these have none, so it does nothing here.

label: Display timeout event
note: Turns on a display timeout event. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Do not disturb
note: Silences call ringing on the glasses while on.
note_zh: 佩戴眼镜期间，眼镜上的来电铃声将被静音。

label: Display off from neural band
label_it: Spegni il display dal Neural Band
label_zh: 用 Neural Band 关闭显示屏
note: Lets the neural band turn the display off.

label: Neural band instant action
note: Action number for the neural band instant gesture. Values are not listed in the code.

label: Glasses setup status
note: Setup progress of the glasses, written by the system. Not for editing. Status written by the system; value names are not defined in the code.

label: Headphone mode
note: Switches the glasses audio to headphone mode.
note_zh: 将眼镜音频切换为耳机模式。

label: Instant action
note: Touchpad instant action, stored as a number. The value names are not decoded yet, so it is read-only. Value names are not decoded; do not write until decoded.

label: Invert wrist roll
note: Would reverse wrist roll direction. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Live transcription in Meta AI
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Companion app setup status
note: Shows how far the phone companion app setup has got. The glasses write it. Status the glasses write during setup; not user-set.

label: Sample setting
note: Sample key from the settings SDK. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Screen reader
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Speaking pitch
note: Pitch of the screen reader voice. The glasses code does not read this key.

label: Speaking rate
note: How fast the screen reader speaks. The phone slider runs from 0 to 100.

label: Display temperature warning
note: For glasses with a display; these have none, so it does nothing here.

label: Simplified touchpad calling
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Zoom level
note: Display magnification mirrored from the phone. The stored int is an index into seven scales.

label: Enable screen reader
note: Copies the phone's TalkBack setting to the glasses.

label: Text size
note: Text size mirrored from the phone. The stored int is an index; the glasses map it to a font scale.

label: Messaging setup status
note: Per-provider linking state for messaging apps, stored as base64 protobuf. The phone app reads it; the glasses do not.

label: Allow input during setup
note: Blocks the assistant trigger while this and setup-complete are both 0. Any non-zero value is on.

label: Suggested replies
note: Show quick, suggested responses based on conversation context.
note_it: Mostra risposte rapide suggerite in base al contesto della conversazione.
note_zh: 根据对话内容显示快捷的推荐回复。

label: Spatial audio
note: Plays media as plain stereo or as spatial audio.

options.label: Stereo
options.detail_it: Ideale per la maggior parte delle esperienze di ascolto

options.label: Spatial
options.detail: Simulates an immersive sound for your media
options.detail_it: Simula un audio immersivo per il tuo contenuto multimediale

label: Spotify Tap
note: Tap and hold the glasses to play Spotify.
note_zh: 点按并长按眼镜即可播放 Spotify。

label: Band on standby: index finger instant action
note: Action for an index finger gesture on standby. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Band on standby: middle finger instant action
note: Key the band sends for a middle-finger instant action on standby. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Tap and hold prompt
note: Prompt the assistant uses for the tap and hold action.

label: Tap and hold action
note: Chooses what a touchpad tap and hold does, such as opening Meta AI or playing music.
note_zh: 设置触控板点按并长按后执行的操作，例如打开 Meta AI 或播放音乐。

options.label: Custom Meta AI prompt
options.label_zh: 自定义 Meta AI 提示语

options.label: Instagram Instants share
options.label_zh: 分享 Instagram 即时照片

label: Telecom untethered relay
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Telecom glasses key ID
note: Identifier of the glasses' telecom encryption key. Stored and synced only.

label: Telecom relay status
note: State of the telecom relay that works without the phone connected, as the phone reports it.

label: Test switch (developer)
note: Developer test switch. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Test float (developer)
note: Test value with no effect. Only the mobile-config defaults and name tables use it.

label: Test int (developer)
note: Developer test value. Nothing on the glasses reads it. Developer test value with no bounds, so nothing to offer.

label: Test int32 (developer)
note: Developer test value. Nothing on the glasses acts on it.

label: Test text (developer)
note: Meta's test key; nothing reads it.

label: Test shared int (developer)
note: Test value for checking settings sync. Nothing on the glasses reads it. Developer test value; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Test shared text (developer)
note: Meta's test key; nothing reads it.

label: Speech speed
note: How fast the glasses speak.
note_zh: 眼镜朗读的语速。

label: Two-stage stabilization
note: Two-stage image stabilization for video.

label: Stabilization buffer size
note: Buffer size for two-stage video stabilisation. The code gives no unit or range, so it is read-only. No unit or bounds in the code, so no range can be offered.

label: Stabilisation buffer size (3K)
note: Stabilisation buffer size for the 3K variant. No code on the glasses uses it.

label: Stabilization neighbor frames
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this count; it is stored and synced only.

label: Stabilisation neighbour frames (3K)
note: Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Stabilized output height
note: Output height in pixels for two-stage stabilization. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Stabilisation output height (3K)
note: Stabilised output height for 3K video. This firmware does not use it.

label: Stabilized output width
note: Output width of stabilized video, in pixels.

label: Stabilisation output width (3K)
note: Stabilised output width for 3K video. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Announce calls
note: Hear who's calling you.
note_it: Senti chi ti sta chiamando.
note_zh: 听到是谁在给你打电话。

label: Verified sessions
note: After a phone unlock, the session stays verified until you take the glasses off.
note_zh: 解锁手机后，会话将保持已验证状态，直到你摘下眼镜。

label: Video length
note: Choose a maximum video length. These limits help optimize for sharing and space.
note_it: Scegli una durata massima del video. Questi limiti aiutano a ottimizzare la condivisione e lo spazio.
note_zh: 选择视频的最大时长。这些限制有助于优化分享和存储空间。

label: Video frame rate
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this value; it is stored and synced only.

label: HDR video
note: Sets the HDR mode for video. Values are not named in the code read. Integer passed to the camera HAL; its value names are not decoded.

label: Stabilization mode
note: Stored and synced only. The camera reads the eis_mode setting instead.

label: White balance
note: Fixed colour temperature for video, 2000 to 8000 K. 0 lets the camera choose.

label: Voice memo eligibility
note: Result of the voice memo eligibility check, written by the system.

label: Voice notes early access
note: Early access switch for voice notes.

label: Audible alerts
note: Assistant will announce device status and errors.
note_it: Assistant annuncerà lo stato del dispositivo e gli errori.
note_zh: 助手会朗读设备状态和错误信息。

label: Wake duration
note: Wake-up duration read by the always-on camera service. The unit and range are not in the binary.

label: Choose hand
note: Which hand the always-on camera tracks for wake gestures.
note_zh: 常亮相机在识别唤醒手势时所追踪的手。

label: Wake-only mode
note: Keeps the always-on camera off until you wake the glasses.

label: Thumb to middle finger distance
note: Distance threshold for the thumb-to-middle-finger wake gesture. The code gives no unit.

label: "Hey Meta"
note: Say "Hey Meta" or "OK Meta" to start a voice command.
note_it: Di' "Hey Meta" o "Ok Meta" per iniziare un comando vocale.
note_zh: 说出 “Hey Meta” 或 “OK Meta” 即可启动语音指令。

label: Wake sound
note: Your glasses will make a sound after you say "Hey Meta" or "OK Meta."
note_it: I tuoi occhiali emetteranno un suono quando dici "Hey Meta" o "Ok Meta".
note_zh: 说出 “Hey Meta” 或 “OK Meta” 后，眼镜会发出提示音。

label: Water eject
note: Clears water from the speaker with an ejection sound.
note_zh: 通过播放排水音效清除扬声器中的积水。

label: Wear detection
note: Features will pause when you take off your glasses and resume when you put them back on.
note_it: Le funzioni saranno messe in pausa quando rimuovi gli occhiali e riprenderanno quando li indossi di nuovo.
note_zh: 摘下眼镜时相关功能将暂停，重新戴上后自动恢复。

label: Glasses encryption key ID
note: ID of the glasses end-to-end encryption key. The phone sets it during relay setup.

label: Glasses relay status
note: State of the relay that works without the phone connected, as the phone reports it. The phone sets it from its relay state machine.

label: Link previews in messages
note: Link previews in messages. Nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Wellness partner 1
note: Nothing on the glasses acts on this switch; it is stored and synced only.
note_zh: 此开关仅用于存储和同步，眼镜上不会有任何功能随之改变。

label: Wellness partner 5
note: Turns on a wellness partner feature flag.

label: WhatsApp contacts sync
note: WhatsApp contact sync status. Stored and synced only; nothing on the glasses reads it.

label: Wi-Fi password
note: Stored on the glasses only. Nothing on the glasses uses it.

label: Wi-Fi network name
note: Name of the Wi-Fi network the glasses join.
